item: Storefront overall height and sign band height
answer_text: Storefront is 3200 high overall, comprising a 2600 shopfront opening to the internal ceiling line and a 600 high sign band above.

item: Display column width, door opening width, fixed glass
answer_text: Across the 2400 frontage: 450 display column + 1500 glazed entrance opening + 450 display column. The opening contains the locked 1000 pivot door and 500 fixed glass panel.

item: Door swing direction and pivot offset
answer_text: Door swings inward; pivot is offset 100 from the right-hand edge when viewed externally, with the 500 fixed glass panel to the left.

item: Is 2400 x 3106 the finished size after plaster?
answer_text: Design assumption: dimensions are clear finished-face internal dimensions after plaster. Verify on site before fabrication.

item: Display frame height
answer_text: Full-height display frame from FFL to ceiling, fixed at floor and soffit.

item: Shelf count and pitch per bay
answer_text: Five display shelf levels per bay including the cabinet top at 600; four further shelves at 400 centres. The final 400 zone reaches the 2600 top frame, so 600 + 5 x 400 = 2600.

item: Base cabinet height and door type
answer_text: 600 high base cabinet with flush, handleless side-hinged doors in a light neutral finish within the black steel frame.

item: Mesh extent on side walls
answer_text: Expanded metal mesh occupies the upper 800 zone, from 1800 AFFL to the 2600 top frame, across all side-wall bays.

item: Rear wall bay width, shelf count, logo size and height
answer_text: The 1900 clear rear-wall width between 250-deep side units is 650 bay + 600 central logo zone + 650 bay. Each display bay follows the five-shelf schedule; the non-illuminated logo is centred at 1900 AFFL.

item: Counter distance from rear wall and staff clearance
answer_text: Set the counter rear edge at y=2156. This gives 700 clear to the face of the 250-deep rear unit at y=2856, and 950 to the rear finished wall.

item: Track positions and lengths, spotlight count
answer_text: Two tracks run parallel with the side walls, symmetrical about the shop centreline. Provide four adjustable spots per track, evenly distributed along each 2206 track.

item: Recessed downlights: keep or omit
answer_text: Keep three small recessed 3000 K downlights in a line over the entrance zone, centred across the storefront opening.

item: Floor-level LED strip: keep or omit
answer_text: Keep concealed 3000 K toe-kick LED strips below both side display runs; one continuous 2406 strip per side.

item: Floor tile extent under display units
answer_text: Continue the porcelain floor across the full finished internal area, beneath all display units and the counter.

item: Exterior and interior sign sizes
answer_text: Scale both logos uniformly from the black SVG at its native 2.21 ratio. Centre the exterior logo in the 600 sign band and the interior logo in the 600 rear-wall logo zone.

item: Fixings, MEP, fire and escape requirements
answer_text: Design assumption: concealed mechanical anchors to verified substrate, dedicated drivers and accessible isolation for LEDs/signage, and a continuous minimum 900 clear escape route. Final anchor type, loads, circuits, fire rating, detector/sprinkler coordination and authority approval require site survey and consultant confirmation.

item: Exterior sign illumination
answer_text: Use black halo-lit/backlit logo elements on 25 standoffs. Omit front-lighting of the sign; entrance downlights serve the threshold only.

item: Storefront display column depth and shelf facing
answer_text: Both storefront display columns are 450 deep with shelves facing the street. Interior side-wall display runs begin behind the columns.

item: Shelf material and thickness
answer_text: Use 3 mm folded mild-steel tray shelves, matte black powder-coated, supported by the 20x20 secondary frame.

item: Entrance threshold, step and level change
answer_text: Provide a flush, step-free threshold at common FFL; coordinate a recessed floor channel and weather seal without a raised sill.

item: Ceiling finish
answer_text: Smooth gypsum ceiling, matte warm off-white, with black tracks and fittings.

item: Floor tile orientation and grout-adjusted cuts
answer_text: Choose option A: 1200 direction across the shop and 600 direction along its depth. With 5 mm perimeter movement joints, use two equal 1194 width cuts and four full 600 rows plus two equal 343 depth cuts; internal grout joints remain 2 mm.

item: North direction
answer_text: Design assumption: north points toward the storefront. Confirm actual orientation from the landlord/site survey before issue for construction.

item: Side bay count, widths and upright spacing
answer_text: Each side run is 3106 - 450 storefront column depth - 250 rear-unit depth = 2406. Divide it into four equal 601.5 bays measured between run boundaries; coordinate 25 mm main uprights within the module.

item: Counter lateral position
answer_text: Offset the counter toward the left to preserve an 800 clear route on the right between the counter and side-unit face. The 100 left gap is a non-circulation service gap.

item: Vertical datum and wall thickness / construction
answer_text: Use finished floor level as +/-0 and treat 2400 x 3106 as finished-face clear dimensions. Assume 100 wall construction and 5 perimeter floor movement joints for coordination only; verify substrate, buildup and levels on site.

item: Counter mesh insert size
answer_text: Provide one centred 300 wide x 450 high black expanded-mesh insert in the 1000 x 900 counter front, with its bottom at 150 AFFL.
